title: Splitting the Middle Term
details: steps: Write the equation as ax² + bx + c = 0 -> Find two numbers whose product is a × c and whose sum is b -> Split the middle term bx using those two numbers -> Group the terms and take out the common factors -> Write it as a product of two linear factors -> Set each factor to zero and solve
use_why: it is a process to draw step by step
